additions.name: DC North Varaždin — existing commercial data-centre operations

status.summary: Original operator post names its DC North facility in Varaždin and explicitly describes it as running, while discussing the existing commercial host and its customers. This supports existing campus operation. No reported MW figure is adopted as achieved IT capacity or measured load; no new opening, completed cloud integration or certification guarantee is asserted.

locator.precision: Native named facility point locates one commercial campus; not a surveyed entrance, building outline or property boundary.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The native record supplies no measured positional accuracy. No city, industrial-zone or company-headquarters point is used.
locator.identity_review: Native facility 16218 names DC North, links dcnorth.hr and gives Ivane Brlić-Mažuranić 30, 42000 Varaždin. The original website explicitly labels that address as the data-centre location; Ilkari separately identifies the same named Varaždin host as its Croatia facility. The native listed organization field CRATIS is preserved literally, without assigning it a current operating or ownership role; its distinct Šetalište F. Tuđmana 1 address and null coordinates are excluded.

additions.distinctness_review: All five canonical 116 tables have no identity, alias, exact address or coordinate matches. Full current and historical queues contain only two unrelated literal DC North references: a US proposed building and a directional bank data-centre neighbour in China. The nearest admitted representative point is nexspace Graz, about 110.5 km away. This is one Varaždin campus; internal rooms, CIX network equipment, CRATIS hosted services and future sovereign-cloud integration are not additional physical sites.
additions.successor_review: Captured original September 9 and October 8 posts, original current company feed through October 28, public feed pagination, operator newsroom and current host pages. October 8 repeats the September interview and does not refresh status; June 24 integration is not a new September event. No later contradictory closure, relocation or cancellation was found. Later general infrastructure, ESG and Colombia event posts do not provide a new Varaždin physical observation.

scoped_project_details.facility_scope: One existing commercial campus; no separate room, tenant, exchange or cloud service admission
scoped_project_details.limitations: No measured load, achieved IT capacity, new opening date, current certification, whole-campus occupancy or property ownership inferred. September 9 records the operator current-operation statement, not an inferred interview or installation date.

additions.name: TSTT Mausica Data Centre — existing commercial operation

status.summary: The original October 20 operator release says the named Mausica campus supports current TSTT services and customers, and quotes EPI’s named representative about present managed operations, processes and trained data-centre staff. This supports existing commercial-host operation. Certification awards and generic standards descriptions are context; no new opening, capacity, performance or actual inspection day is inferred.

locator.precision: Named physical-campus anchor from the native feature; not a surveyed footprint, industrial-zone centroid, office geocode or isolated telecom tower point.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The native map supplies no quantified positional accuracy; decimal precision is not surveyed accuracy.
locator.identity_review: The native feature exactly names TSTT Mausica Data Centre and gives the official TSTT domain, with a broader Telecommunications service provider category. EPI’s own registry identifies the named Mausica campus at #1 Pineapple Drive, D’Abadie; the native Waze DC and Exchange feature on Pineapple Drive lies 28.975 metres away. Google’s Mausica Road and the Pineapple Drive variants remain distinct as reported. The selected point locates one campus; Waze contributes identity context only.

additions.distinctness_review: All five canonical 116 tables and 4078 current/historical source, definition, hold, queue and review files were screened by exact campus/operator names, street, native feature ID and coordinate strings. There are zero scoped baseline or queue matches. All four integration20 additions are already canonical 116. No current Trinidad and Tobago campus is present; the nearest existing representative point is Blue NAP Curaçao, about 851.23 km away. Certifications, services and the exchange label do not create a second physical campus.
additions.successor_review: The current original TSTT news page and feed were reviewed, including the exact October 21 post. That later post describes a certificate presentation earlier in the month and does not refresh current physical operation or establish an inspection day. A bounded later-report search found no contradictory named-campus closure or relocation. Map opening hours or a closed-now display are not physical-closure evidence. Historical 2017 completion remains separate from the selected October 20 existing-operation report.
